name: Quarto
description: Installs the Quarto CLI from its checksum-verified official release tarball and records an install receipt.

version.description: Select or enter a stable Quarto version (e.g. 'latest' or '1.10.19').

checksumsSha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the release's quarto-<version>-checksums.txt. Pins every asset of that release independently of GitHub; requires an exact version.
